The Yacht Club

Join the Yacht Club and step into our iconic sail-and-boom-shaped clubhouse, standing proudly on the Jeddah Waterfront.

Home to a myriad of exceptional experiences, it’s your place to explore new adventures or find retreat – in peaceful solitude or among a community of like-minded people.

Apply Now

Step into a realm of private sanctuaries

Network over breathtaking views of the Red Sea and Jeddah skyline at Riva Privée. Relax at the Cigar Lounge, complete with a curated selection of fine cigars and private humidors. For dining, try Marina Social, led by Michelin-starred chef Jason Atherton, offering a Mediterranean culinary journey with live entertainment and waterfront views.

Enjoy priority hotel & berth bookings

Enjoy priority access to marina berthing and luxury hotel accommodations. With 95 berths accommodating yachts up to 120 meters, the marina offers top-tier docking facilities, ensuring a hassle-free experience for yacht owners. Members also receive priority bookings at the club’s luxury hotel, featuring 63 elegantly designed rooms.

Discover The Hotel
Explore The Marina

Access private concierge services

As a member, your dedicated Guest Relations Officer will provide bespoke services tailored to your unique lifestyle, handling all arrangements and queries. You also enjoy personalized shopping and dining experiences, along with priority access through complimentary valet and members-only parking areas.

Network with business leaders & yachting enthusiasts

Gain access to a unique network of like-minded professionals from the worlds of business, luxury, and yachting. Connect over shared passions at intimate social events, foster collaborations in our state-of-the-art boardrooms, and host gatherings on the Terrace.
